6.6. Flight Tests in Physical Urban Environment
Following our at-altitude tests, we conducted a number of ﬂight tests in close proximity to physical
buildings, as part of the Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency (DARPA) OFFensive Swarm-
Enabled Tactics (OFFSET) ﬁeld exercises. The ﬁrst building we ﬂew around was at the Joint
Base Lewis-McChord CACTF. Based on our prior experiments, we increased our nominal building
stand-oﬀdistance from 2 to 4 meters to prevent our vehicle from ﬂying too close to the corners.
Two of the three trials were successful (see Figure 14), with one of the trials clipping the corner of
the building due to wind.
